properties.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8706264 and 8706003 (mapped 2001-03-20, 2003-08-27; active), joined into one outline; the earlier outline came from: DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8706264); name/address from Mission Housing's own project page and press coverage; OpenStreetMap way 679290110 tags the footprint but carries no name/address of its own
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's block-by-block reconciliation pass, cross-checking OCII's own numbered Land Use Map (Dec 2019, data/manual/_reference/mission_bay_land_use_map_2019.png) against everything already tracked: Rich Sorro Commons, a 101-unit supportive housing building at 150 Berry St for people living with HIV/AIDS and their families, developed by Mission Housing Development Corporation, built 2002 (174,100 sq ft). Also houses a Head Start early-childhood center (152 Berry St) on the ground floor. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrected the description above against Mission Housing's project page and the DBI permit. Both say 100 rental units (the permit: 'erect a 5 story 100 unit residential bldg'), not 101. The page describes it as serving 'families and people with AIDS/HIV' and as 'the first affordable family housing development' in Mission Bay; it does not call it 'supportive housing'. It gives 158,000 square feet, not 174,100, which appears in no source read. It lists 'a childcare center' on the ground floor; it does not name Head Start or give 152 Berry St, so those details are unsourced. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has the union of Assessor lots 8706264 and 8706003 (6,453 m2, active, mapped 2001-03-20, 2003-08-27); the earlier outline of 4,651 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.66 (95% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 69% of the lot). The outline is now their union using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous digitized_from: 'DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8706264); name/address from Mission Housing Development Corporation's own project page and press coverage; OpenStreetMap way 679290110 tags the footprint but carries no name/address of its own'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed DataSF Building Footprints outline (mblr SF8706264), name/address from Mission Housing Development Corporation's own project page and press coverage; OpenStreetMap way 679290110 tags the footprint but carries no name/address of its own; not a hand trace or plan estimate. '. 2026-10-12 (text only; no change to the outline, status, use or geometry_type): accuracy_caveat corrected -- it said the roll cites lot 8706264 at 150 Berry St, but DataSF's secured roll (wv5m-vpq2) lists lot 8706264 at 213 King St (Commercial Retail, no units, year built 2003) and puts this building's data under lot 8706003 (150 Berry St, Multi-Family Residential, 101 units, year built 2002). Previous accuracy_caveat sentence: 'The building spans two Assessor lots, 8706264 and 8706003, which DataSF's Assessor layer records at the same address (150 Berry St); the roll cites lot 8706264.' 2026-10-12 audit (text only; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type): the 2026-09-29 entry's figures were re-read on Mission Housing's project page: 'The 158,000-square-foot, four-story Type V wood frame structure over a concrete podium contains 100 rental units, an 85-car parking garage, ground floor retail/commercial space, a childcare center' (the 'ADDED' entry's 101 units, 174,100 sq ft, Head Start centre at 152 Berry St and 'supportive housing' are retracted there and stay retracted; the DBI permit 200004187592 reads 'erect a 5 story 100 unit residential bldg'). The page footer reads '© 2022 by Mission Housing' and says 'We have been the community's affordable housing developer since 1971'; the full name 'Mission Housing Development Corporation' used in the entries above is not on the page, so digitized_from now says 'Mission Housing'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is the union of Assessor lots 8706264 and 8706003 (6,453 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (DataSF Building Footprints (mblr SF8706264)); 95% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 69% of the lot. The building spans two Assessor lots, 8706264 and 8706003, which DataSF's parcel layer lists on Berry St (8706264 as 150 Berry St, 8706003 as 150-152 Berry St). The Assessor's secured roll puts the building's data under lot 8706003 (150 Berry St, Multi-Family Residential, 101 units, year built 2002); the roll's entry for lot 8706264 is for 213 King St (Commercial Retail, no units, year built 2003), so the roll does not cite lot 8706264 for this building.
